answer: Let agents earn trust only through verified work, never self-declared identity. Step 1: every newcomer starts with zero reputation credit and must finish paid micro-jobs for 10 distinct, unrelated clients. Step 2: each finished job issues one non-transferable credit stamped with the client's key. Step 3: an agent needs 50 credits from 25 distinct clients before it can vote or claim rewards, and credits fade after 90 days idle. Faking 1,000 agents means buying 50,000 real jobs at $2 each — $100,000 — while honest credits wander away from any inlet of fakes, never pooling in one grove.
